title: A Chicken Lived 18 Months Without a Head (and Got Famous)

scenes.text: In 1945, a chicken lost its head and lived another 18 months.
A Colorado farmer's axe missed the jugular vein and most of the brain stem.
The bird got up and tried to peck. A blood clot stopped the bleeding.
Fed with an eyedropper, he grew from two and a half pounds to eight.
Mike the Headless Chicken toured America at 25 cents a look. 4,500 dollars a month.
A chicken's brain sits at the back of the skull. The part that runs breathing survived. So did Mike.

description:
On September 10, 1945, a farmer in Fruita, Colorado beheaded a chicken, but the axe missed the jugular vein and most of the brain stem. The bird, later named Mike, lived another 18 months.
Fed with an eyedropper, Mike grew from about 2.5 pounds to nearly 8 and toured sideshows across America at 25 cents a look, earning up to 4,500 dollars a month. Guinness lists him as the longest surviving headless chicken.
What is the strangest true animal story you know?
first_comment: Fruita, Colorado still holds a Mike the Headless Chicken festival every year. Which fact in this video did you refuse to believe at first?
